name: upgrade-impact-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating service upgrade impact on dependent services and overall fleet stability

options.description: Upgrade has minimal expected impact on dependent services based on historical compatibility data
Upgrade has moderate expected impact but manageable with careful sequencing and monitoring
Upgrade has high expected impact on dependent services or historical data shows frequent compatibility issues
Insufficient historical data to accurately assess upgrade risk; recommend additional testing or gradual rollout

evaluation_factors: Frequency of compatibility issues in similar upgrades
